arguments.sql:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT product_code, COUNT(*) AS sale_rows, MIN(date) AS first_date, MAX(date) AS last_date
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly
    WHERE date >= '2021-01-01' AND date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY product_code
)
SELECT MIN(s.first_date) AS first_date, MAX(s.last_date) AS last_date,
       (SELECT SUM(sale_rows) FROM sales) AS source_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_code IS NOT NULL THEN s.sale_rows ELSE 0 END) AS joined_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_code) AS codes, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product) AS names,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.division) AS divisions
FROM sales AS s
LEFT JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code

arguments.sql:
WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT p.division, p.product, SUM(s.sold_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS s
    JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
    WHERE s.date >= '2021-01-01' AND s.date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY p.division, p.product
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT total_quantity,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY division
               ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, product
           ) AS division_rank
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT AVG(total_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity_sold
FROM ranked_products
WHERE division_rank <= 3
LIMIT 1
